evals.name: liquid-instinct-trap
evals.prompt: In Klaviyo I need a block in our promo email that shows different copy for our three loyalty tiers (Gold, Silver, Bronze, stored on the profile as `loyalty_tier`), and falls back to generic copy for the ~30% of the list with no tier set. Give me the code.
evals.expected_output: Uses {% if %}/{% elif %}/{% else %}, NOT {% elsif %}. No {% assign %}. Correct filter syntax with no space after the colon. Handles the missing-tier case.

evals.name: shopify-cart-loop
evals.prompt: We're on Shopify and I'm building the abandoned cart email in Klaviyo, triggered off Checkout Started. I need the product block — image, product title, price, and a link back to the product, max 3 items, plus a button back to the cart. Paste-ready please, our product names sometimes have apostrophes.
evals.expected_output: Uses event.extra.line_items with correct Shopify sub-paths, event.extra.checkout_url for the cart link, builds the product URL from organization.url + product.handle, limits with |slice, and notes this only works in a metric-triggered flow.

evals.name: blank-personalization-debug
evals.expected_output: Identifies the space after the filter colon AND {% elsif %} as the two hard errors, explains that one bad tag kills the entire render, and separately identifies that event data does not exist in campaigns as the cart cause.
